Everything checks out. The patch file and the applied fix in the source are correct.

## Fix Complete

**Bug:** "Undo with last list item does not work" — when the last item is swiped out and the Undo snackar action is pressed, the restored item appears off-screen.

**Root cause:** Race condition in `QueueFragment.onFragmentLoaded()`. The RecyclerView visibility toggle (`View.GONE`/`View.VISIBLE`) executes synchronously while item removal animations are still in-flight. When Undo restores the item via `addQueueItemAt()`, the `notifyItemInserted()` call fires on a RecyclerView that's mid-visibility-transition, causing the item to render off-screen.

**Fix:** Wrap the visibility toggle in `recyclerView.post()` so it defers to the next UI loop tick, after all pending adapter notifications and animations settle.

**File changed:** `app/src/main/java/de/danoeh/antennapod/fragment/QueueFragment.java` (lines 508-517)

**Patch file:** `patch-fix-bug-1130.patch`

**Build:** Verified clean — `BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 52s`
